_comment: Data validity rules and UIS API configuration. Matches UIS bulk download conventions.

validity.note: Records with MAGNITUDE in excluded list, or whose INDICATOR_ID starts with an excluded prefix, are treated as not observed/reported data.

coverage.note: A country is covered if it has at least one valid record with YEAR strictly greater than threshold_year.

population.emc_id_note: Total population, all ages, both sexes

avoid: evaluative adjectives such as poor, weak, alarming, impressive, strong
attributing data gaps to country behaviour or capacity
preferred: note years for which data are available or not available
use passive constructions when describing gaps
